text: Speaking of partnerships, scientists just discovered that leucine - that's a protein found in meat, beans and nuts - can supercharge our cellular batteries called mitochondria. Basically, good tucker makes our cells run better.

speaker: alice
text: And there's breakthrough news for quantum computing too. Researchers created entirely new forms of matter by tweaking magnetic fields over time, making quantum systems way more stable and error-resistant.

speaker: charlie
text: The future's looking pretty bright when breakfast can boost your cell power and scientists are literally creating new kinds of matter. Time for our weather with Sam.
